name: Dusk Apiary Observatory

sensors.module: Seengreat/Xicoolee BME688 breakout, RT9193-33 regulator, I2C 0x77
sensors.enclosure: sensor inside the hive body; ESP32-S3 in a vented box outside

notes: Three-hive apiary with weight, CO2, acoustics, bee counting and a weather station. The BME688 is on hive3.
